newsitem.title: CANADA: Gulf Canada to take over Stampeder.
newsitem.headline: Gulf Canada to take over Stampeder.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd and Stampeder Exploration Ltd said in a joint statement on Monday that they agreed that Gulf would acquire Stampeder in a C$1 billion share swap deal.

Gulf said it would offer 0.69124 of a Gulf share for each Stampeder share. Based on Stampeder's closing price of C$5.70 on July 25, the offer represents a premium of 31 percent. The exchange ratio was based on the July 24 closing share price of C$10.85 for Gulf and a value of C$7.50 for each Stampeder share. That represents a a total value of about C$1 billion, based on 98.5 million shares outstanding on a fully diluted basis and about C$300 million in net debt.

The two companies said that under the agreement, the board of Stampeder agreed to pay Gulf a breakup fee of C$20 million (about C$0.20 a share) if the Gulf bid was unsuccessful under certain circumstances.
